blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Nearly 20,000 police personnel, members of partner agencies, and civilian volunteers have been deployed across Eastern Visayas to ensure public safety during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day or Undas. The Police Regional Office 8 (PRO-8) said it mobilized 19,972 personnel and force multipliers from Oct. 29 to Nov. 3 to maintain peace and order in cemeteries, churches, transport terminals, major thoroughfares, and tourist destinations. Brig. Gen. Romano Cardiño, the regional police director, placed PRO-8 under full alert status from 12:01 a.m. on Oct. 30 until 12:01 a.m. on Nov. 3 to ensure the […]...
